title: Spanish Coconut Croquetas
description: A crunchy and airy twist on traditional Spanish croquetas, this recipe combines the flavors of coconut and ham in a crispy fried ball.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F.
In a medium bowl, mix together the coconut flakes, ham, flour, breadcrumbs, egg, onion, garlic powder, and salt.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter.
Once the oil is hot, carefully place the croquetas in the oil and fry for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Remove the croquetas from the oil with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the croquetas hot and enjoy!
